However, it does not reconstruct the target Pd@PtRuFeCoNi high-entropy-alloy shell, its HER/HOR conditions, element-specific active sites, metastable thermal behavior, or quantitative outcomes. The proposed comparison has some discriminating value, but strain changes geometry and adsorption-site structure in addition to the d-band center, while alloying changes ensemble chemistry; these confound attribution unless treated as separate series with independent structural controls.
